Three simple signs show a small business needs immediate web assistance.

Many map listings show a business address but no website link, so they lose online inquiries.

Older websites often omit phone numbers or mobile contact details, causing visitors to leave quickly.

Broken links or missing call buttons on mobile make it hard for customers to reach you.

I run a daily script that scans local listings and records these gaps in a spreadsheet.

You can use these signals to offer web improvements, and you only pay after you approve the work.

replies.reply: It depends on the cities and categories you want to target. Quick question: what service do you offer, and who do you usually pitch to? You pay only after you approve the work.

replies.reply: Yes, it is built specifically for that because the filter flags businesses with no site, missing contact details, or broken pages. Which location are you currently targeting?

replies.if_they_say: Can you send a sample sheet?
replies.reply: I do not keep pre-made sample files, but I can configure a fresh run for your specific target category and city. You inspect the work first and pay only after you approve it. What kind of clients are you looking for?
